PA topic coding examples: (1) County Code authority allowing county appropriations to municipal corporations for disaster/emergency aid is local government and governance (2401). (2) A legislative resolution requesting DEP reporting on environmental statute violations, enforcement actions, and department accounts funded by environmental fines/penalties is environment (700), even though it mentions agency accounts and reporting. (3) A recognition resolution for a professional concert band is arts/culture (609). (4) Public School Code changes to Commonwealth reimbursement for vocational-technical programs are vocational education (604), even when the bill also makes an appropriation. General application: classify by the substantive policy being addressed; incidental appropriations, reporting, or recognition language need not determine the topic. Do not extend these examples beyond their described subjects without checking the codebook.

Additional examples and rules: Steel Products Procurement Act applicability is state/domestic procurement preference (2007). Absentee ballot delivery, voting supplies, and election lists are election administration (2012). Indirect initiative and referendum are ballot measures/direct democracy (2017). A university appropriation specifically for cardiovascular studies is health/medical research (398); education grants through the Higher Education Assistance Agency are higher education finance (601). Prothonotaries' notice to tax assessors about amicable judgments is court administration/judicial procedure (1204). Requiring drivers to use headlights when windshield wipers operate is highway safety/vehicle operation (1006). Restroom access rules intended to ensure equitable facilities for women are gender equality (202). Lottery Fund rules changing the income limit for elderly pharmaceutical assistance are elderly benefits/pharmaceutical assistance (335). Stadium and exposition facilities authority is local economic development/stadium financing (1403). Eliminating fair share fees for Commonwealth employees and changing employee organization obligations is public employee labor relations (2004). Requiring insurers to provide policyholders complete copies of insurance policies is insurance regulation (1505).
